Agent Host 已通过真实模型请求验证连接: Agent Host verified the connection with a real model request
请先填写 API 代理地址: Enter the API proxy address first
已从上游获取 {count} 个模型，请在下方启用并编辑参数: Fetched {count} models from upstream. Enable them and edit their parameters below.
OpenAI Codex 需要 ChatGPT 订阅授权与令牌刷新，不能安全地当: OpenAI Codex requires ChatGPT subscription authorization and token refresh, so it cannot be stored safely as a regular API Key. This page is included in the Provider catalog; enabling it opens once the Agent Host OAuth callback flow is connected.
使用 Agent Host 所在环境的 AWS/GCP 凭证链，不会把密钥写入项: Uses the AWS/GCP credential chain of the environment where Agent Host runs; keys are never written to project configuration.
必须包含 http(s)://；留空时使用 Pi 内置端点。: Must include http(s)://; leave empty to use the built-in Pi endpoint.
新建聊天默认使用此服务商和模型。: New chats use this provider and model by default.
通过隔离运行时向当前模型发送最小请求。: Sends a minimal request to the current model through an isolated runtime.
你的密钥使用 AES-256-GCM 加密；Web/远程工作负载仅接收 Vaul: Your key is encrypted with AES-256-GCM; web and remote workloads receive only a Vault placeholder, and the desktop runtime uses controlled masked injection.
正在从上游获取模型与参数…: Fetching models and parameters from upstream…
输入动态网关中的模型 ID: Enter a model ID from the dynamic gateway
暂无模型，点击「获取模型」从上游拉取。: No models yet. Select "Fetch models" to pull them from upstream.
启用此服务商前需要填写 API Key。: Enter an API Key before enabling this provider.
已保存的密钥无法解密，请重新输入 API Key 并保存。: The saved key cannot be decrypted. Re-enter the API Key and save.
当前模型尚未启用。: This model is not enabled yet.
模型参数无效，请检查上下文窗口与最大输出限制。: Invalid model parameters. Check the context window and max output limits.
上游未返回任何模型，请检查 Base URL 或 API Key。: Upstream returned no models. Check the Base URL or API Key.
无法从上游获取模型，请检查 API 代理地址与 API Key。: Could not fetch models from upstream. Check the API proxy address and API Key.
无法连接 Agent Host 或模型服务。: Could not connect to Agent Host or the model service.
向量模型已保存为知识库默认模型；现有索引将在重建后切换。: The vector model was saved as the knowledge base default; existing indexes switch after a rebuild.
默认本机地址。Ollama 的兼容 API 不要求密钥。: Default local address. Ollama's compatible API does not require a key.
必须包含 http(s)://；可填写托管或本地 inference 服务地址。: Must include http(s)://; use the address of a hosted or local inference service.
填写该服务实际提供的 embedding 模型 ID。: Enter the embedding model ID that the service actually provides.
必须与该模型实际输出维度一致。模型或维度变更后，知识库需要重新建立 Zero 索: Must match the actual output dimension of the model. After changing the model or dimension, the knowledge base needs a fresh Zero index.
{apiKeyLabel}；本地服务通常可留空。: {apiKeyLabel}; local services can usually leave this empty.
知识库在未显式选择模型时使用这里的默认向量模型。: The knowledge base uses this default vector model when no model is explicitly selected.
密钥经 AES-256-GCM 加密，只有 Knowledge Service: The key is encrypted with AES-256-GCM, and only the Knowledge Service can decrypt it for index requests.
安装并运行 Ollama 后，在系统终端执行 `ollama pull <模型名: After installing and running Ollama, run `ollama pull <model name>` in your terminal; once saved, OpenLink uses that model through the local API.
Hugging Face Local 使用 TEI。下载模型并启动 TEI 服务: Hugging Face Local uses TEI. Download a model and start the TEI service, then point the address above at that service; model files are cached and managed by TEI.
该向量服务需要 API Key: This vector service requires an API Key
请检查模型 ID、协议和向量维度: Check the model ID, protocol, and vector dimension
配置 Pi Agent 使用的模型服务商。密钥经 AES-256-GCM 加密，: Configure the model providers that Pi Agent uses. Keys are encrypted with AES-256-GCM and injected through the Credential Vault in an isolated runtime.
配置知识库和 Zero 使用的 Embedding 模型。向量配置和普通聊天模型: Configure the Embedding models used by the knowledge base and Zero. Vector configuration is stored separately from standard chat models, and keys are only handed to the trusted Knowledge Service.
Zero 只负责索引与检索。变更默认模型或向量维度后，已有知识库必须以新模型重新: Zero only handles indexing and retrieval. After changing the default model or vector dimension, existing knowledge bases must be re-indexed with the new model so different vector spaces never mix in the same collection.
